metadata.topic: Waves — Sound Wavelength; Optics — Speed of Light in Water and Critical Angle
metadata.note: Three short calculations from Q3: sound wavelength (3 marks), speed of light in water (2 marks), critical angle of water-air boundary (3 marks). Grouped as they share wave/optics context.

question.name: CSEC Phy Jun 2023 Q3 — Sound Wavelength and Optics Calculations
question.text:
Part (b)(ii) — Sound: A sound wave travels through air at 330 m s⁻¹. Calculate the wavelength of a sound wave with frequency 11 000 Hz. (3 marks)

Part (c)(ii) — Refraction: The refractive index of water is n = 1.3. Calculate the speed of light in water (speed of light in air = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). (2 marks)

Part (c)(iii) — Critical angle: Calculate the critical angle for a water-air boundary (n = 1.3). (3 marks)
question.general_feedback:
(b)(ii) Wavelength of sound:
λ = v/f = 330 / 11 000 = 0.030 m (= 3 cm)

(c)(ii) Speed in water:
v_water = c / n = 3 × 10⁸ / 1.3 = 2.31 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹

(c)(iii) Critical angle:
sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.3 = 0.769
c = arcsin(0.769) = 50.3°

steps.label:
Formulas: v = fλ → λ = v/f    v_medium = c/n    sin(critical angle) = 1/n
Constants: c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ (speed of light in air)
Q3b(ii) — Calculate the wavelength of sound at 11 000 Hz in air. (3 marks)
Q3c(ii) — Calculate the speed of light in water (n = 1.3). (2 marks)
Q3c(iii) — Calculate the critical angle for the water-air boundary. (3 marks)

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: λ = v ÷ f = 330 ÷ 11 000 = 0.030 m. Check you divided speed by frequency (not multiplied).
error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Wave equation: v = fλ → λ = v/f. Divide wave speed by frequency.

fields.label: Speed of light in water v = _____ × 10⁸ m s⁻¹

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: v_water = c / n = (3 × 10⁸) / 1.3 = 2.31 × 10⁸ m/s. Divide by refractive index.
error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: v_medium = c / n. Light is slower in a denser medium — divide c by n.

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: sin(c) = 1/n = 1/1.3 = 0.769. Divide 1 by the refractive index.
error_codes.SC_FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Critical angle formula: sin(c) = 1/n (for light going from the denser medium to air).

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: c = arcsin(1/n) = arcsin(0.769) = 50.3°. Use the inverse sine (sin⁻¹) function on your calculator.
error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Make sure your calculator is in degree mode, not radians. arcsin(0.769) should give approximately 50°.
